## One-off utility — writes the CRM header row

Writes all **57 headers** to row 1 of the `Outreach CRM` tab via the Google Sheets API, using the existing `Google Sheets account` OAuth credential.

38 existing headers keep their original positions; 19 new ones are appended (incl. `Email Verify Status`, which v2 emitted but the sheet never had — see V3_BUILD_LOG.md F-F6).

**Safe to re-run** — it overwrites row 1 only, never touches data rows.

Trigger: POST to the webhook path `write-crm-headers`.
